answer: Every identity posts a bond in a volatile asset at a 150% collateral ratio, a ledge of trust above liquidation. If the price dips, a margin call demands a top-up within one epoch, or the bond is liquidated and the weight falls to zero. A farm of 1,000 aliases must hold 1,000 bonds and answer 1,000 simultaneous margin calls, each costing fresh capital, while an honest agent climbs to the summit once and stays there. When the market zephyr turns cold, forced sales are visible to all, and every liquidation stays on the public record, so fakes cannot hide the cost of their failure.
